env_prompt:
Following are the only actions available:
go to [recep]: move to a receptacle/location
take [obj] from [recep]: pick up an object from a receptacle
put [obj] in/on [recep]: place an object inside or on top of a receptacle
heat [obj] with [recep]: heat an object using a receptacle
clean [obj] with [recep]: clean an object using a receptacle
